qc.label_under_test: the word that opens a time-span quantity ('in one to two weeks', 'over three days', 'in the first half of'), on the token before the number or unit

neighbours.label: the word that opens a time-span quantity ('in one to two weeks', 'over three days', 'in the first half of'), on the token before the number or unit
fire: The wound usually closes in one to three weeks.
Flowers appear in two to four months.
Her cough cleared over six days.
The company will report in the second half of 2024.
The tadpoles change in one to two months.
Tickets sold out over two weekends.
He healed in the first half of the season.
The paint dries in three to five hours.
quiet: My keys are in one of these two bags.
The recipe calls for two to four eggs.
Our team climbed over six fences.
The lawyer read the second half of the contract.
A stack of one to two hundred pages arrived.
The horse jumped over two logs.
She painted the first half of the wall.
Each box holds three to five pens.

notes: A re-test of my QC 2026-11-06-lm1909-d642865a, whose near misses shared the whole prefix up to the firing token, so those pairs read the same by construction. Here every near miss has its own lead-in, with a number or range in a non-time frame. Registered as a dispute because the label's own forms ('over four days', 'first half') read low before.
